APIAuth.description: APIAuth holds the token list for Gateway API authentication.

include.description:
Include is a path (relative to the blueprint file) to a YAML file with a
"tokens:" list (same shape as the inline tokens below). Expanded at load
time — the result is merged into Tokens, with inline entries taking
precedence per token name.

tokens.description:
Tokens is the list of accepted bearer tokens. Every Gateway API request
must include Authorization: Bearer <token> matching one entry.

APISecretRef.description: APISecretRef locates a Kubernetes Secret that holds a bearer token.

key.description: Key is the data key within the Secret whose value is the token.

name.description: Name is the Kubernetes Secret name.

namespace.description:
Namespace is the Secret's namespace. Required on an external: call's
auth (in a Blueprint or an e2e step); for gateway API tokens and the
remote reconciler's auth it defaults to Inrun's own namespace.

rotateAfter.description:
RotateAfter is an optional duration (e.g. "90d", "720h").
When set, the gateway checks the inrun.dev/generated-at annotation on
the Secret; if the age exceeds this duration, it deletes and recreates
the Secret with a new uuidv4 token.

APIToken.description: APIToken is one bearer token entry.

githubOIDC.description:
GitHubOIDC authenticates callers via GitHub Actions OIDC tokens.
No secret is required — the gateway verifies the JWT signature against
GitHub's public JWKS and matches the claims in the allow block.

gitlabOIDC.description: GitLabOIDC authenticates callers via GitLab CI OIDC tokens.

name.description: Name is a human-readable identifier used in logs and audit output.

oidc.description:
OIDC authenticates callers via any OIDC-compliant identity provider.
Issuer is required; the gateway discovers the JWKS URI via
{issuer}/.well-known/openid-configuration.

secretRef.description:
SecretRef reads the token value from a Kubernetes Secret at startup.
If the Secret does not exist, the gateway creates it with a generated
uuidv4 token. If rotateAfter is set, the gateway rotates the token
using the same annotation-based rotation as pkg/runners.

token.description:
Token is an ${ENV_VAR} reference expanded at startup.
Set the variable via extraEnv in the gateway and console Helm values.
Literal values are not accepted.

vaultOIDC.description:
VaultOIDC authenticates callers via HashiCorp Vault OIDC tokens.
The caller authenticates to Vault first (via any Vault auth method), then
presents a Vault-issued OIDC token to the gateway. No stored secret needed.
The gateway discovers the JWKS via {url}/v1/identity/oidc/.well-known/openid-configuration.

alias.description:
Alias — Go import alias for the API types package. Optional.
Auto-derived from the last two segments of Location if not set.
e.g. "projv1" → import projv1 "github.com/.../project/v1alpha1"

apiPath.description:
APIPath — REST API path prefix. Default: /apis.
Override to /api only for core Kubernetes types (Pod, ConfigMap, etc.)
Almost always leave this empty — Inrun defaults it to /apis.

group.description:
Group — Kubernetes API group. Required in all modes.
e.g. "platform.inrun.dev"

kind.description:
Kind — resource Kind. Required in all modes.
e.g. "Platform"

location.description:
Location — fully qualified Go import path for the API types package.
Required for typed mode. Used by inrun generate for import statements
and the type's SchemeAdderFns entry.
Not needed for dynamic mode — omit entirely.
e.g. "github.com/intentd/inrun/api/types/project/v1alpha1"

plural.description:
Plural — lowercase plural resource name. Required in all modes.
Used for REST client URL construction.
e.g. "projects"

version.description:
Version — API version. Required in all modes.
e.g. "v1alpha1"

AdmissionConfig.description: AdmissionConfig groups all admission and versioning rules under crdEntry.admission:.

conversion.description: Conversion handles multi-version CRD conversion via a webhook or built-in strategy.

mutation.description: Mutation declares mutation rules applied to incoming CRs at admission time.

validation.description: Validation declares CEL/webhook validation rules evaluated at admission time.

webhooks.description: Webhooks controls per-CRD admission webhook behaviour.

AdmissionWebhookConfig.description: AdmissionWebhookConfig is the per-CRD admission webhook control block.

mutation.description:
Mutation — include this CRD in the MutatingWebhookConfiguration.
Default: true when mutation rules are declared.

operations.description:
Operations — which operations trigger the webhook.
Default: ["CREATE", "UPDATE"]
Valid values: CREATE, UPDATE, DELETE, CONNECT

validation.description:
Validation — include this CRD in the ValidatingWebhookConfiguration.
Default: true when validation rules are declared.

AdmissionWebhookToggle.description: AdmissionWebhookToggle controls whether admission webhooks are globally enabled.

enabled.description:
Enabled controls whether ValidatingWebhookConfiguration and
MutatingWebhookConfiguration are registered at startup.
Default: ENABLE_ADMISSION_WEBHOOK env / false.

AllowedNamespaces.description: AllowedNamespaces holds the set of allowed namespace patterns.

Auth.description: Auth is the authentication envelop for handling both ENV-based token and secret reads for cross: authentication

secretRef.description:
SecretRef locates a Kubernetes Secret whose data key holds a bearer token
Mutually exclusive with Token. inrun validate enforces this

token.description: Token is a bearer token for the endpoint. $ENV_VAR syntax supported.

AutoscaleAction.description: AutoscaleAction declares the override values to apply when conditions are met.

queueDepth.description: QueueDepth — maximum queue depth before backpressure.

resync.description:
Resync — resync interval override. How frequently all CRs are
re-enqueued regardless of changes.

workers.description: Workers — number of concurrent reconcile goroutines.

AutoscaleConditions.description: AutoscaleConditions holds the condition blocks for autoscale evaluation.

or.description:
Or — OR semantics. At least one condition in this list must be true.
Supports all Condition kinds: time, dayOfWeek, cron, and metric fields.

when.description:
When — AND semantics. All conditions in this list must be true.
Supports: metric conditions (metrics.*, cross.<crd>.metrics.*).

AutoscaleSpec.description: AutoscaleSpec declares the autoscale behavior for one operatorbox.

conditions.description:
Conditions declares the trigger conditions. Both blocks must pass
when both are declared (AND between blocks, OR within or).

cooldown.description:
Cooldown is the minimum time conditions must be continuously false
before the baseline is restored. Prevents oscillation when metrics
fluctuate around a threshold.
Default: 2m

do.description:
Do declares the override values applied when conditions are met.
Fields omitted in Do are not changed — only declared fields are overridden.

interval.description:
Interval is how often the autoscaler evaluates conditions.
Shorter intervals respond faster to load changes at the cost of
more frequent evaluation overhead (negligible in practice).
Default: 15s

preset.description:
A preset is:
	a named preset that expands into a complete autoscale configuration
using computed heuristics tuned for a specific behavior pattern

BlueprintDeprecation.description: BlueprintDeprecation carries deprecation guidance for registry consumers.

message.description: Message — shown to consumers alongside the deprecation warning.

migratedTo.description: MigratedTo — the pattern that replaces this one.

timeline.description: Timeline — from: when warnings start; to: the end-of-life date.

BlueprintFile.description: BlueprintFile is the top-level structure of a blueprint.yaml file.

crossAccess.description:
CrossAccess sets the default cross-read policy for all CRDs in this Blueprint.
When false, no other Blueprint may read any CRD in this one via cross:.
Individual CRDs may override with their own crossAccess field.
Defaults to true (open) when not declared.

functions.description:
Functions declares user-defined functions available to all CRDs in this Blueprint.
Functions are named template expressions that compose built-in functions and Go template
syntax. Once declared, a function is callable by name in any template expression.

gateway.description:
Gateway declares how the gateway is deployed for this Blueprint.
When gateway.standalone: true, the gateway runs without a runtime operator
and spec: may be empty.

imports.description:
Imports — Blueprints a Stack composes, from files, a registry or Helm
charts. Stack only.

kind.description: Kind — Blueprint for a Blueprint, Stack for a Stack that imports Blueprints.

lifecycle.description: Lifecycle — maturity, deprecation and compatibility, read by the CLI.

metadata.description:
Metadata — name, version, author, license, tags and description, shown
by inrun validate, inspect and the registry.

policy.description: Policy — what a Stack allows its imports to be. Stack only.

presets.description:
Presets declares named presets available to all CRDs in this Blueprint.
Presets are resolved before built-in Inrun presets at both validate
and reconcile time. Template expressions in preset field values are
resolved at reconcile time; validation skips fields that contain {{ }}.

publish.description:
Publish declares the publishing and consumer policy for this pattern.
Controls signing requirements and which quality gates run at push time.
Distinct from security: — publish: is about supply chain, not runtime admission.

security.description:
Security — service names, deletion and namespace protection, webhooks,
conversion and cert-manager settings for the gateway.

spec.description: Spec — the CRDs and how each is reconciled.

BlueprintLifecycle.description: BlueprintLifecycle is the top-level policy block for a Blueprint.

accept.description: Accept is only valid on a Stack. It acknowledges lifecycle concerns of imported patterns.

compatibility.description:
Compatibility — the Kubernetes and Inrun versions this pattern is
verified against.

deprecation.description: Deprecation — when this pattern is deprecated, and what replaces it.

maturity.description: Maturity — alpha, beta, stable or deprecated.

BlueprintLifecyclePolicy.description: BlueprintLifecyclePolicy holds lifecycle-related enforcement rules within a policy: block.

minMaturity.description:
MinMaturity sets the minimum lifecycle maturity allowed for imported patterns.
Imports below this floor are errors at inrun validate time rather than warnings.
Valid values: alpha, beta, stable (deprecated imports are always errors without accept).

BlueprintMeta.description: BlueprintMeta holds identifying metadata for a Blueprint.

author.description: Author identifies the creator or maintainer of the Blueprint.

clusterName.description:
ClusterName identifies the cluster this Blueprint runs in.
Used by the Console for cluster-level filtering when multiple
runtimes are connected. Blueprint value takes precedence over the
CLUSTER_NAME env var. Empty when neither is set.

description.description: Description provides a human-readable explanation of the Blueprint's purpose.

license.description: License describes the licensing terms under which the Blueprint is distributed.

name.description: Name is the required unique identifier of the Blueprint.

namespace.description:
Namespace scopes this Blueprint to a logical tenant or team within a single
runtime. Defaults to "default" when not declared — identical to Kubernetes
namespace semantics. The Console groups CRDs by namespace so each
team sees only its own panel.

tags.description:
Tags are optional keywords for categorising the Blueprint in the Inrun Registry.
They aid discovery (e.g., "database", "stateful", "security") when using
`inrun patterns --tag <tag>` and for indexing in Artifact Hub.
Tags have no effect on runtime behaviour.

version.description: Version follows semantic versioning (e.g., "1.2.3") for the Blueprint schema or content.

BlueprintPolicy.description: BlueprintPolicy declares platform-level enforcement rules for a Stack.

lifecycle.description: Lifecycle — the lowest maturity an import may have.

BlueprintSecurity.description: BlueprintSecurity holds the full security configuration for a Blueprint.

certManager.description:
CertManager controls the lifecycle of Inrun's auto-generated TLS certificate.
Only applies when certificates are auto-generated (TLS_CERT/TLS_KEY not set).

nil pointer: use ENV defaults (TLS_AUTO_ROTATE, TLS_ROTATION_THRESHOLD).

conversion.description:
Conversion controls the /convert endpoint and CRD version conversion.
Separate from admission webhooks — conversion has its own endpoint and
configuration (window size for stats, etc.).

nil pointer: conversion not configured; ENV vars drive behavior.

deletionProtection.description:
DeletionProtection controls whether Inrun registers a webhook that
blocks deletion of its managed CRDs, deployment, service, etc.

When enabled (default when block is present):
  - Registers /deletion-protection endpoint on the HTTPS server
  - Creates ValidatingWebhookConfiguration "inrun-deletion-protection"
  - Entry 1: broad rule for CRDs; handler filters by DeletionProtectedCRDNames()
  - Entry 2: ObjectSelector-gated rule for deployment, service, etc

To decommission an operator with deletion protection:
  1. Set enabled: false
  2. Redeploy Inrun (webhook removed on startup)
  3. Delete resources normally

nil pointer: not enabled (not declared in YAML).

namespaceProtection.description:
NamespaceProtection controls the optional validating webhook that prevents
Inrun-managed CRs from being created or updated in forbidden namespaces.

This is an admission-time safeguard only. When enabled:
  - Registers /namespace-protection endpoint on the HTTPS server
  - Creates ValidatingWebhookConfiguration "inrun-namespace-protection"
  - Enforces allowedNamespaces / restrictedNamespaces declared by each CRD

If disabled or omitted, namespace rules are not enforced at apply time.
Existing CRs in forbidden namespaces will still be reconciled normally.

nil pointer: namespace protection not configured; ENV vars drive behavior.

serviceName.description: ServiceName defines the runtime and gateway service names for the Inrun deployment.

webhooks.description:
Webhooks controls the admission webhook settings (ValidatingWebhookConfiguration,
MutatingWebhookConfiguration). These apply globally — there is no per-CRD switch.
CRDs declare validation/mutation rules; the webhook is enabled or not globally.

nil pointer: admission webhooks not configured; ENV vars drive behavior.

BlueprintSources.description: BlueprintSources declares where to load CRD definitions from.

files.description:
Files — local paths, remote URLs, or environment variable references.
Each entry must be a valid Blueprint YAML (apiVersion, kind, spec.crds).
Supports environment variable references: $MY_BLUEPRINT_URL

Simple form: just a path string (no auth)
  files:
    - ./blueprints/project.yaml
    - https://public.url/blueprint.yaml
    - $MY_BLUEPRINT_URL

Authenticated form: a FileSource struct with auth block
  files:
    - url: https://private.url/blueprint.yaml
      auth:
        type: bearer
        fromEnv: MY_TOKEN

helm.description:
Helm — Helm chart sources. Each chart is rendered with the provided
value files and the resulting Blueprint templates are extracted and merged.

BlueprintSpec.description: BlueprintSpec holds the actual CRD definitions.

crds.description:
CRDs — the CRD entries managed by this Inrun instance.
Map key is the CRD name; Name field is injected from the key during loading.

finalizers.description:
Finalizers — Blueprint-level finalizers applied to all CRDs
unless overridden at the CRD level.

imports.description:
Imports declares Modules whose presets are merged into the Blueprint-wide
PresetRegistry. Only presets: from each Module are consumed here;
resources, status, and admission declarations in the Module are ignored
at this level. Use spec.crds[name].imports for those.

CRDConversion.description: CRDConversion declares declarative version conversion rules for a CRD.

include.description:
Include is a path (relative to the blueprint file) to a YAML file whose
top-level value is a list of ConversionPath entries under a "paths:" key.
Expanded at load time — included paths come first, inline paths append after.

manageCRD.description:
ManageCRD — when true and Inrun generates the webhook certificate, Inrun
owns the CRD's spec.conversion: it points the conversion webhook at the
gateway with the generated CA, at startup and again whenever it drifts.
With a certificate configured in security.webhooks you configure
spec.conversion yourself, and this field has no effect.
Default: true on the entry that declares paths, false on a participant.

participant.description:
Participant marks this CRD as a conversion participant without declaring
conversion paths. Use this on the stable/storage-version CRD when the
conversion paths are declared on the other version. Both CRDs need to
be marked (one with paths, one with participant: true) for conversion
stats to appear for each in the Console.

paths.description:
Paths — one entry per (from, to) pair.
You need at least two paths for a two-version CRD:
  - old → storage  (up-conversion)
  - storage → old  (down-conversion)

storageVersion.description:
StorageVersion — the version all objects are stored as internally.
All conversion paths route through this version.

Info.description: Info collects additional validation information for this CRD

Warnings.description: Warnings collects non‑fatal validation messages for this CRD.

admission.description: Admission groups validation, mutation, conversion, and webhook configuration.

annotations.description:
Annotations attaches additional metadata annotationa to CRs of this entry.
Not used for reconciliation filtering — see AnnotationSelector for that.

apiTypes.description: See APITypes for full field documentation.

blueprintDescription.description:
BlueprintDescription — the description from the source Blueprint's metadata.
Falls back to the Stack's description when the sub-Blueprint has none.

blueprintName.description: BlueprintName — unique identifier for the blueprint in the runtime.

blueprintNamespace.description:
BlueprintNamespace — the namespace this CRD's Blueprint belongs to.
Defaults to "default" when not declared. Used by the Console to
group CRDs by team/tenant within a single runtime.

blueprintVersion.description:
BlueprintVersion — the version from the source Blueprint's metadata.
Falls back to the Stack's version when the sub-Blueprint has none.

crFiles.description:
CRFiles is an ordered list of CR YAML files to apply before the runtime
starts. Applied in declaration order after the CRD is registered.
Same path resolution as CRDFile. Dev mode only.

crdFile.description:
CRDFile is the path to the CRD YAML file to apply before operator start.
Supports relative (resolved from blueprint file location), absolute, or
remote (https://…) paths.

Only applied when running outside the cluster (dev mode via inrun).
In production, CRDs must be pre-applied by the platform operator.

During inrun validate, the file is read and its group/kind are checked
against apiTypes to catch mismatches before deployment.

crossAccess.description:
CrossAccess controls whether other Blueprints can read this CRD's CR state
via the cross: block. Defaults to true (readable). Set to false to opt
this CRD out of cross reads — the reconciler returns empty for any
cross: reference that targets an opted-out CRD.

dependsOn.description:
DependsOn — names of other CRDs that must reach a condition before this one starts.
Inrun resolves the dependency graph and starts CRDs in topological order.
Cycle detection runs at validation time — cycles fail fast with a clear error.
Supports three YAML formats (list, key-value, full map) — see DependsOnMap.

description.description: Description — human-readable description. Shown in /blueprint API responses.

enabled.description:
Enabled — include this CRD in the runtime. false = skipped entirely.
WARNING: only set to false after stripping Inrun finalizers from all
live CRs — disabled CRDs with live finalizers will cause stuck objects.

endpoints.description: Endpoints defines which operator HTTP endpoints are enabled for this CRD.

enrich.description:
Enrich turns on the enrichments named (pods, events, replicasets, …),
each always or only when its when/or conditions pass. Set this or
enrichAll, not both.

enrichAll.description:
EnrichAll turns on every enrichment: objects related to the children in
.children, such as a Deployment's pods and replica sets, or events. Set
this or enrich, not both.

fieldSelector.description:
FieldSelector filters resources by server-side field expressions.
Supports exact-match on well-known metadata paths only
(e.g. "metadata.name", "metadata.namespace").
Evaluated server-side, before client-side label filtering.

forceConflict.description:
ForceConflict, when true, sets Force: true on every server-side apply
for the resources created on onCreate/onReconcile CRD, taking
ownership of conflicting fields instead of returning a conflict error.
Default: true.

labelSelector.description:
LabelSelector filters which resources are watched and reconciled.
Required for built-in types (ConfigMap, Pod, etc.) to avoid reconciling
every instance in the cluster. Optional for custom CRDs.

labels.description:
Labels attaches additional metadata labels to CRs of this entry.
Not used for reconciliation filtering — see LabelSelector for that.

migrate.description: Migrate Declares that CRs of this kind migrate to another CRD

mode.description:
Mode — see CRDMode for full documentation.
Auto-detected when omitted based on whether apiTypes.location is set.

namespace.description:
Namespace — target namespace for namespace-scoped CRDs.
Informer watches this namespace only. Empty = all namespaces.

namespaced.description:
Namespaced — true if this CRD is namespace-scoped, false if cluster-scoped.
Default is true

serve.description:
Serve exposes this CRD through the Gateway API as a stable delivery surface.
When enabled, the Console renders a [+ Create] button for this CRD
and serves its schema via GET /api/v1/schema/{kind}.

setup.description:
Setup declares prerequisite resources to apply before Inrun starts.
Shorthand: a plain list of strings applies each file

workersActive.description: WorkersActive — records number of active concurrent reconcile workers for this CRD.

CRMigrate.description: CRMigrate is a CRD's migrate block.

prune.description:
Prune deletes each source once its destination holds every source
field. Kind level only; the CLI asks first unless --yes.

selection.description: Selection restricts which CRs are migrated. Empty means all.

to.description:
To names the destination CRD. Leave it out to only scope field-level
(serve.fields migrate.from) migrations.

CRMigrateMetadata.description: CRMigrateMetadata is the destination's labels and annotations.

annotations.description:
Annotations set on each destination CR; they win over copied source
annotations.

labels.description: Labels set on each destination CR; they win over copied source labels.

apiVersion.description:
APIVersion — the destination CRD's group and version, e.g.
"platform.example.com/v2".

carryStatus.description:
CarryStatus copies the source's status onto the destination. Off by
default: status is what the destination's controller has observed.

crdFile.description:
CRDFile fills APIVersion, Kind and Plural at load (declared values
must match) and lets validation check scope and schema.

metadata.description: Metadata — labels and annotations for the destination CRs.

namespace.description:
Namespace is used only when a cluster-scoped source moves to a
namespaced destination, and is required then.

plural.description: Plural is used for RBAC; inferred from Kind when empty.

CallSpec.description: CallSpec is one HTTP call: what an external call (reconcile.external) and the remote reconciler's request and finalize calls have in common.

auth.description:
Auth declares the credential for this call. For the remote request:
default remote.auth.

body.description:
Body is the request body for POST/PUT/PATCH. Template expressions supported.
  body: '{"name": "{{ .metadata.name }}"}'
HTTP only.

expectedStatus.description:
ExpectedStatus lists the HTTP status codes that count as success, e.g.
[200, 404] for a read where "not found" is an answer. HTTP only.
Default: any status below 400.

headers.description:
Headers are additional HTTP headers. Values are templates, like url and
body; names are literal. Credentials belong in auth, not here. HTTP only.
  headers:
    X-Tenant: "{{ .metadata.namespace }}"

idempotencyKey.description:
IdempotencyKey controls the key Inrun sends on POST and PATCH so a
retried write is not applied twice. Absent: sent as Idempotency-Key with
a key derived from the CR's UID and the request. HTTP only.
  idempotencyKey: false
  idempotencyKey: {header: PayPal-Request-Id}

method.description:
Method is the HTTP method. Default: GET for external calls, POST for
the remote request. HTTP only.

or.description: Or — at least one condition must pass, alongside When.

timeout.description:
Timeout is the maximum duration for this call. Format: "5s", "1m",
"500ms". Default: 10s for external calls, remote.timeout for the
remote request.

url.description:
URL is the endpoint or connection string. Template expressions supported.
  url: "{{ .spec.serviceUrl }}/health"
  url: "redis://redis-svc:6379"
For the remote request and finalize: default remote.endpoint.

when.description: When — every condition must pass for the call to be made this pass.

CertManagerConfig.description: CertManagerConfig controls Inrun's built-in TLS certificate lifecycle.

autoRotate.description:
AutoRotate controls whether Inrun pre-emptively rotates the TLS certificate
before it expires. The new certificate takes effect on the next gateway restart.
Default: true. Set to false or TLS_AUTO_ROTATE=false to opt out.

rotationThreshold.description:
RotationThreshold is how far before expiry Inrun rotates the certificate.
Accepts duration strings: "30d", "7d", "2w". Default: "30d".

validFor.description:
ValidFor is the validity period of the certificate.
Accepts duration strings: "30d", "7d", "2w". Default: "1y".

CleanupConfig.description: CleanupConfig declares when to delete a CR.

after.description:
After is an optional grace period between the conditions being met and
the deletion. Inrun annotates the CR with the first-met time, so the clock
survives restarts. Zero means delete immediately.

or.description:
Or declares OR conditions — at least one must be true.
When both When and Or are declared, both must pass.

when.description: When declares AND conditions — all must be true.

ClusterRoleBindingTemplateSource.description: ClusterRoleBindingTemplateSource declares one cluster-scoped ClusterRoleBinding to be managed by Inrun.

forEach.description:
ForEach declares dynamic expansion over a list field.
When set, one source declaration becomes N declarations — one per list element.
.item and .<as> are available in template expressions within this declaration.

	forEach:
	  field: spec.regions
	  as: region

forceConflict.description:
ForceConflict, when true, sets Force: true when applying this resource,
taking ownership of conflicting fields instead of returning a conflict error.
Overrides the CRD-level ForceConflict setting.

labels.description: Labels — applied to ClusterRoleBinding metadata. Values support template expressions.

name.description:
Name — ClusterRoleBinding name.
Default when omitted: "{{ .metadata.name }}-crb"

or.description: Or lists conditions of which at least one must pass, alongside When.

reconcile.description:
Reconcile: true — also apply this declaration as drift correction on every
reconcile. Equivalent to declaring the same entry under both onCreate and
onReconcile. When false (default), only runs on onCreate (idempotent create).

roleRef.description:
RoleRef — the ClusterRole this binding grants. Required.
kind defaults to "ClusterRole" when omitted (the only valid target for a
ClusterRoleBinding).

	roleRef:
	  name: "{{ .metadata.name }}-cluster-role"

subjects.description:
Subjects — the users, groups, or ServiceAccounts this binding grants
the role to. Required: at least one subject.

	subjects:
	  - kind: ServiceAccount
	    name: "{{ .metadata.name }}-sa"
	    namespace: "{{ .metadata.namespace }}"

when.description:
When lists conditions that must all pass for this entry to be written; see
Condition. When an entry kept in sync (onReconcile, or reconcile: true)
stops passing, the object it wrote is removed.

ClusterRoleTemplateSource.description: ClusterRoleTemplateSource declares one cluster-scoped ClusterRole to be managed by Inrun.

forEach.description:
ForEach declares dynamic expansion over a list field.
When set, one source declaration becomes N declarations — one per list element.
.item and .<as> are available in template expressions within this declaration.

	forEach:
	  field: spec.regions
	  as: region

forceConflict.description:
ForceConflict, when true, sets Force: true when applying this resource,
taking ownership of conflicting fields instead of returning a conflict error.
Overrides the CRD-level ForceConflict setting.

labels.description: Labels — applied to ClusterRole metadata. Values support template expressions.

name.description:
Name — ClusterRole name.
Default when omitted: "{{ .metadata.name }}-cluster-role"

or.description: Or lists conditions of which at least one must pass, alongside When.

reconcile.description:
Reconcile: true — also apply this declaration as drift correction on every
reconcile. Equivalent to declaring the same entry under both onCreate and
onReconcile. When false (default), only runs on onCreate (idempotent create).

rules.description:
Rules — the permissions granted by this ClusterRole. Required: at least one rule.

	rules:
	  - apiGroups: [""]
	    resources: ["namespaces"]
	    verbs: ["get", "list", "watch"]

when.description:
When lists conditions that must all pass for this entry to be written; see
Condition. When an entry kept in sync (onReconcile, or reconcile: true)
stops passing, the object it wrote is removed.

Condition.description: Condition is one test against the CR or runtime state.

between.description: Between passes when the field's number is inside an inclusive "min,max" range.

contains.description: Contains passes when the field's value contains this text.

cron.description:
Cron — a standard cron expression (5-field) that defines when the
window opens. Duration defines how long the window stays open.
Without Duration, the window stays open until the next fire. Add Duration to close it sooner.

dayOfWeek.description:
DayOfWeek — active on the specified days of the week.
  or:
    - dayOfWeek:
        in: [Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday]

duration.description: Duration — how long a cron-opened window remains active.

equals.description: Equals passes when the field's value is exactly this text.

exists.description:
Exists, when true, passes when the field is present and non-empty. A
condition with no comparison at all means exists.

field.description:
Field — dot-notation path to a field in the CR object or a runtime metric.
e.g. "spec.environment", "metrics.queueDepth", "cross.managed-database.metrics.queueDepth"

greaterThan.description: GreaterThan passes when the field's number is above this one (strict).

in.description: In passes when the field's value is one of a comma-separated list.

lessThan.description: LessThan passes when the field's number is below this one (strict).

max.description: Max is an inclusive upper bound: the field's number is at most this.

min.description: Min is an inclusive lower bound: the field's number is at least this.

negate.description:
Negate — when true, the result of this condition is inverted.
Applies to all condition types: field comparisons, time windows, dayOfWeek, cron.

  when:
    - dayOfWeek:
        weekday: true
      negate: true   # passes on weekends

notBetween.description: NotBetween passes when the field's number is outside an inclusive "min,max" range.

notContains.description: NotContains passes when the field's value does not contain this text.

notEquals.description: NotEquals passes when the field's value is not this text.

notExists.description: NotExists, when true, passes when the field is absent or empty.

notIn.description: NotIn passes when the field's value is none of a comma-separated list.

notPrefix.description: NotPrefix passes when the field's value does not start with this text.

notSuffix.description: NotSuffix passes when the field's value does not end with this text.

prefix.description: Prefix passes when the field's value starts with this text.

regex.description: Regex passes when the field's value matches this RE2 pattern.

source.description:
Source is the HTTP fallback for cross-binary metric observation.
Only used when field is a cross.<crd>.metrics.* field and the CRD
is not registered in GlobalCrossMetricsRegistry (different binary).
The endpoint must be the remote operator's /blueprint/{crd} URL.

  when:
    - field: cross.managed-database.metrics.queueDepth
      greaterThan: "500"
      source:
        host: "http://inrun-database-operator:8080"
		   crd: managed-database
  when:
    - field: cross.managed-database.metrics.queueDepth
      greaterThan: "500"
      source:
        endpoint: "http://non-inrun-database-operator:8080/api/managed-database/metrics"

suffix.description: Suffix passes when the field's value ends with this text.

time.description:
Time — active when the current time is within the declared window.
After and Before are both optional; omit one for a half-open range.
  or:
    - time:
        after: "08:00"
        before: "20:00"

typeOf.description:
TypeOf passes when the field's value has this type: map, slice,
string, number, bool or null (the names the typeOf function returns).

unique.description:
Unique, when true, passes when no other instance of the CRD has the same
value at Field. Always passes where no uniqueness checker is available
(e2e, simulate without a seeded fixture).

ConfigMapTemplateSource.description: ConfigMapTemplateSource declares one ConfigMap to be managed by Inrun.

data.description:
Data — static key-value configuration entries.
Values are plain strings — template expressions are not supported here.

forEach.description:
ForEach declares dynamic expansion over a list field.
When set, one source declaration becomes N declarations — one per list element.
.item and .<as> are available in template expressions within this declaration.

forceConflict.description:
ForceConflict, when true, sets Force: true when applying this resource,
taking ownership of conflicting fields instead of returning a conflict error.
Overrides the CRD-level ForceConflict setting.

fromConfigMap.description:
FromConfigMap — name of an existing ConfigMap to copy data from.
Inrun reads this at reconcile time — copies stay in sync with the source.

fromNamespace.description:
FromNamespace — namespace where FromConfigMap lives.
Default: same namespace as the CR.

labels.description: Labels — applied to ConfigMap metadata. Values support template expressions.

name.description:
Name — ConfigMap name.
Default when omitted: "{{ .metadata.name }}-config"

namespace.description:
Namespace — target namespace.
Default when omitted: "{{ .metadata.namespace }}"

or.description: Or lists conditions of which at least one must pass, alongside When.

reconcile.description:
Reconcile: true — also apply this declaration as drift correction on every
reconcile. Equivalent to declaring the same entry under both onCreate and
onReconcile. When false (default), only runs on onCreate (idempotent create).

toNamespaces.description:
ToNamespaces - a list of target namespaces
Default when omitted: "{{ .metadata.namespace }}"

when.description:
When lists conditions that must all pass for this entry to be written; see
Condition. When an entry kept in sync (onReconcile, or reconcile: true)
stops passing, the object it wrote is removed.

ConstructorDeclaration.description: ConstructorDeclaration declares where a custom reconciler constructor lives.

alias.description:
Alias — the import alias in generated code. Default: derived from
location.

fetch.description: Fetch: when true, inrun generate runs go get <location>@<version>.

function.description: Function — the function constructing the reconciler.

location.description: Location — the Go import path of the package that holds the function.

version.description: Version — the module version inrun generate fetches when fetch is true.

Container.description: Container is one container of a pod, for the containers and initContainers of every pod kind (pods, deployments, replicaSets, statefulSets, jobs, cronJobs).

args.description: Args — arguments to the entrypoint; each element supports template expressions.

command.description: Command — the entrypoint; each element supports template expressions.

env.description:
Env — environment variables, in Kubernetes list format; values support
template expressions. Merged over the entry's env by name.

envFrom.description: EnvFrom — load every key of Secrets and ConfigMaps as environment variables.

image.description: Image — container image. Required. Supports template expressions.

imagePullPolicy.description: ImagePullPolicy — Always, IfNotPresent or Never. Omit for the Kubernetes default.

name.description: Name — must be unique in the pod. Required. Supports template expressions.

port.description:
Port — the port the container listens on, as a string. Probes without a
port use it. Static: "8080". Dynamic: "{{ .spec.port }}".

probes.description: Probes — startup, liveness and readiness probes. Not allowed on an init container.

protocol.description: Protocol — for port: TCP (default), UDP or SCTP.

resources.description: Resources — requests and limits, or resources.preset for a named preset.

securityContext.description: SecurityContext — container security settings, or securityContext.preset.

volumeMounts.description:
VolumeMounts — volumes from the entry's volumes, mounted into this container.
Merged over the entry's volumeMounts by mount path.

ConversionConfig.description: ConversionConfig controls the /convert endpoint and CRD version conversion.

conversionWindow.description:
ConversionWindow is the rolling window size for latency/throughput stats.
Default: CONVERSION_WINDOW env / 100.

enabled.description:
Enabled controls whether the /convert endpoint is registered and the
CRD conversion webhook is active.
Default: ENABLE_CONVERSION env / false.

ConversionPath.description: ConversionPath declares one explicit conversion mapping.

spec.description:
Spec — the output spec in the target version's format.
Values support Go template expressions evaluated against the source object.
Static values are used as-is.

CronJobTemplateSource.description: CronJobTemplateSource declares one CronJob to be managed by Inrun.

args.description: Args — container arguments. Each element supports template expressions.

command.description: Command — container entrypoint. Each element supports template expressions.

concurrencyPolicy.description:
ConcurrencyPolicy — how to handle a scheduled run that overlaps with a
still-running previous Job.
Accepted values: allow (default — runs concurrently), forbid (skip the
new run), replace (cancel the running Job and start the new one).

containers.description:
Containers — the pod's containers, when it runs more than one. With
containers set, image, command, args and resources move into each
container, and this entry's securityContext becomes a default every
container inherits. See Container.

failedJobsHistoryLimit.description:
FailedJobsHistoryLimit — number of failed Jobs to keep around for
inspection. Default: 1.

When set, one source declaration becomes N declarations — one per list element.
.item and .<as> are available in template expressions within this declaration.

	forEach:
	  field: spec.regions
	  as: region

forceConflict.description:
ForceConflict, when true, sets Force: true when applying this resource,
taking ownership of conflicting fields instead of returning a conflict error.

imagePullSecrets.description:
ImagePullSecrets is an optional list of references to secrets in the same namespace to use
for pulling any of the images used by this PodSpec.
If specified, these secrets will be passed to individual puller implementations for them to use.

initContainers.description:
InitContainers — run in order, each to completion, before the containers
start. See Container.

labels.description: Labels — applied to CronJob metadata. Values support template expressions.

name.description:
Name — CronJob name.
Default when omitted: "{{ .metadata.name }}-cronjob"

namespace.description:
Namespace — target namespace.
Default when omitted: "{{ .metadata.namespace }}"

nodeSelector.description:
NodeSelector is a selector which must be true for the pod to fit on a node.
Selector which must match a node's labels for the pod to be scheduled on that node.
More info: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/configuration/assign-pod-node/

+mapType=atomic
